verdict.rationale: RudderStack ships a documented MCP server (works with Claude, Cursor, VS Code Copilot, etc.) that lets an agent debug delivery errors, monitor pipelines, write/test transformations, review tracking plans and audit logs via natural language, and a general HTTP API docs page claims to let you 'programmatically manage your RudderStack connections, transformations and other RudderStack features.' However, the evidence never explicitly confirms agent-driven creation of new sources/destinations or wiring of streams (no OpenAPI spec was found, and MCP feature list is centered on inspection/debugging/transformations rather than provisioning). Missing for 10: explicit API/MCP endpoints for creating sources and destinations, wiring stream connections, and a discoverable OpenAPI/schema confirming full CRUD pipeline management.
